0x0F00032D = Timer 13 | Write: frames; it counts down by 1 every frame the object moves (not in hitlag) and stops at 0.\nRead: frames left (0 = done). Per object. Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F00032E = Timer 14 | Write: frames; it counts down by 1 every frame the object moves (not in hitlag) and stops at 0.\nRead: frames left (0 = done). Per object. Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F00032F = Timer 15 | Write: frames; it counts down by 1 every frame the object moves (not in hitlag) and stops at 0.\nRead: frames left (0 = done). Per object. Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F000330 = Kinetic type | Read: the object's current kinetic type (what Set_Kinetic_Handler sets). Write: change it (works for projectiles too). Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F000331 = Tracking frames left | Read: frames of Track_Target left (-1 = until stopped). Write: set them; 0 stops tracking. Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F000332 = Speed X | Read only: the object's current X speed (all its kinetic energies). Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F000333 = Speed Y | Read only: the object's current Y speed (all its kinetic energies). Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F000334 = Team | Read only: the object's team (-1 = none). Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F000335 = Hurt team | Read only: the team whose attacks can't hit it (-1 = none); Track_Target skips a fighter whose hurt team is the tracker's attack team. Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F000336 = Attack team | Read only: the team its attacks can't hit (-1 = none; a projectile's is its owner's, or the reflector's after a reflect). Needs tools/acmd_ext_cave.py.
0x0F0000A0 = Self hit | Target: this fighter.\nRead: 1 once its current attack has connected (until the move ends or it is reset), else 0.\nWrite (any value): back to 0, so a later hitbox can be checked on its own (as ACMD Hit_Reset).
0x0F0000A1 = Self hit now | Target: this fighter.\nRead: 1 only on the frame its attack connects, else 0.
0x0F0000A2 = Self status | Target: this fighter.\nRead: its status kind (e.g. 0x59 shield break).\nWrite: change its status to the value (e.g. 0x59 = shield break, 0x5D = dizzy).
0x0F0000A3 = Self motion | Target: this fighter.\nRead: its motion kind (its own motion list's number).\nWrite: play that motion from frame 0 (the motion number is per fighter).
0x0F0000A4 = Self motion frame | Target: this fighter.\nRead: its current motion frame. Writes are ignored.
0x0F0000A8 = Nearest opponent hit | Target: the nearest other fighter.\nRead: 1 once its current attack has connected (until the move ends or it is reset), else 0.\nWrite (any value): back to 0, so a later hitbox can be checked on its own (as ACMD Hit_Reset).
0x0F0000A9 = Nearest opponent hit now | Target: the nearest other fighter.\nRead: 1 only on the frame its attack connects, else 0.
0x0F0000AA = Nearest opponent status | Target: the nearest other fighter.\nRead: its status kind (e.g. 0x59 shield break).\nWrite: change its status to the value (e.g. 0x59 = shield break, 0x5D = dizzy).
0x0F0000AB = Nearest opponent motion | Target: the nearest other fighter.\nRead: its motion kind (its own motion list's number).\nWrite: play that motion from frame 0 (the motion number is per fighter).
0x0F0000AC = Nearest opponent motion frame | Target: the nearest other fighter.\nRead: its current motion frame. Writes are ignored.

0x0F0001A9 = Slot 3 special pressed | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: 1 only on the frame the special button is pressed, else 0.\nWrite: 1 = hold it (until 0 is written), 2 = press it for one frame, 0 = stop forcing it.\nForcing is cleared when the fighter is KO'd, respawns, or at the match's entrance / results.
0x0F0001AA = Slot 3 jump pressed | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: 1 only on the frame the jump button is pressed, else 0.\nWrite: 1 = hold it (until 0 is written), 2 = press it for one frame, 0 = stop forcing it.\nForcing is cleared when the fighter is KO'd, respawns, or at the match's entrance / results.
0x0F0001AB = Slot 3 shield pressed | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: 1 only on the frame the shield button is pressed, else 0.\nWrite: 1 = hold it (until 0 is written), 2 = press it for one frame, 0 = stop forcing it.\nForcing is cleared when the fighter is KO'd, respawns, or at the match's entrance / results.

0x0F0001B0 = Slot 3 stick x | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: control stick X along the fighter's facing (-1 to 1, positive = forward).\nWrite: force the stick to it (until STICK_FORCED is written).
0x0F0001B1 = Slot 3 stick y | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: control stick Y (-1 to 1, positive = up).\nWrite: force the stick to it (until STICK_FORCED is written).
0x0F0001B2 = Slot 3 cstick x | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: C-stick X along the fighter's facing (-1 to 1).\nWrite: force the C-stick to it (until STICK_FORCED is written).
0x0F0001B3 = Slot 3 cstick y | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: C-stick Y (-1 to 1).\nWrite: force the C-stick to it (until STICK_FORCED is written).
0x0F0001B4 = Slot 3 stick forced | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: 1 while a stick is forced.\nWrite (any value): stop forcing both sticks.
0x0F0001B5 = Slot 3 input off | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: 1 while the fighter's own inputs are ignored.\nWrite: 1 = ignore its buttons and sticks (forced ones still work), 0 = back on.
0x0F0001B6 = Slot 3 situation | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: 0 on the ground, 1 on a ledge, 2 in the air.\nWrite: set it (StatusModule(2, value); the status doesn't change).
0x0F0001B7 = Slot 3 damage | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: damage %.\nWrite: set it (the counter updates).
0x0F0001B8 = Slot 3 jumps used | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: jumps used (int 0x10000001).\nWrite: set it (0 gives every jump back).
0x0F0001B9 = Slot 3 jumps max | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: jumps it has in all (int 0x10000002).\nWrite: set it.
0x0F0001BA = Slot 3 shield hp | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: shield health (float 0x3).\nWrite: set it.
0x0F0001BB = Slot 3 intangible | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: body state: 0 normal, 1 invincible, 2-4 intangible (the stronger of the status's own and the timed one).\nWrite: intangible for N frames.
0x0F0001BC = Slot 3 invincible | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: 1 while invincible (body state 1).\nWrite: invincible for N frames.
0x0F0001BD = Slot 3 armor | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: armor: 0 none, 1 super armor, 2 knockback-based, 3 damage-based.\nWrite: set it (with ARMOR_THRESHOLD's value for 2 / 3).
0x0F0001BE = Slot 3 armor threshold | Target: player slot 3.\nRead: the armor's threshold (knockback for 2, damage for 3).\nWrite: set it (write it before ARMOR).
